AGENT_VOIP.REOPEN_ON_INCOMING: Open/reopen conversations for incoming calls (respect the inbox conversation policy)
AGENT_VOIP.HISTORY_COMPANY_HELP: Use the exact company ID that owns the extensions. Recovery does not infer company scope from phone numbers.

DIAGNOSTICS.RESET_CURSOR_HELP: History still retained by the PBX will be read again without deleting ViperChat data. Duplicate protection remains enabled; records already removed at the source cannot be recovered.
DIAGNOSTICS.TITLE: Diagnostics
DIAGNOSTICS.HELP: Service reception, processing and recovery status. No call content or credentials are displayed.
DIAGNOSTICS.ERROR: Unable to load diagnostics or perform this action. Check service permissions and configuration.
DIAGNOSTICS.QUEUED: Request queued. Refresh to follow processing.

RECOVERY_STATE.idle: Up to date / awaiting next query

DIAGNOSTICS.GAP_DETECTED: A recovery gap was detected. The PBX may no longer retain older records; a complete history cannot be guaranteed.
DIAGNOSTICS.HAS_MORE: More records remain for subsequent recovery pages.
DIAGNOSTICS.TRUNCATED: Showing up to 25 events and 25 artifacts. The totals above include other pending records.
DIAGNOSTICS.CONFIRM_RECOVERY: Read incremental history for this service and queue recoverable records?
DIAGNOSTICS.CONFIRM_REPROCESS: Queue a new attempt for this record? Duplicate protection remains enabled.
DIAGNOSTICS.CONFLICT: The record is already complete, its source changed, or a recent request exists. Refresh diagnostics before trying again.

ARTIFACTS.TITLE: Recording and analysis
ARTIFACTS.LOAD_ERROR: Unable to load the recording. Please try again.

PUBLICATION.pending_conversation: Awaiting safe identification of an existing conversation.
PUBLICATION.ambiguous: Multiple conversations match. Note not published to avoid an incorrect association.

AGENT_VOIP.INTEGRATION_PENDING: Saving does not prove connectivity. Configure the producer and confirm event delivery before relying on this integration.
AGENT_VOIP.WEBHOOK_SOURCE_HELP: Enter the stable source_instance_id used by the producer. Keep it unchanged to preserve event correlation.
AGENT_VOIP.WEBHOOK_COPY_FAILED: Unable to copy. Select and copy the URL manually.
AGENT_VOIP.WEBHOOK_SAVE_FIRST: Save the service, then reopen it to obtain its dedicated webhook URL.
AGENT_VOIP.WEBHOOK_AUTH_HELP: Configure the producer to POST events to this URL with the api_access_token header containing an existing account administrator's API token. Obtain it through the administrator's profile. Do not enter that token here or share it with agents.
AGENT_VOIP.HISTORY_REST_HELP: Use the base URL, without /v1/console/history. The backend uses the existing history endpoint for recovery. Credentials are never shared with the webphone.
AGENT_VOIP.NO_EXTENSIONS: No extensions configured in this account.
AGENT_VOIP.WSS_REQUIRED: Use a valid wss:// address for the SIP service. ws:// is allowed only on localhost in development; a LAN IP also requires WSS.
AGENT_VOIP.FAVORITE_REMOVAL_HELP: Only the shortcut will be removed. The contact and call history will be preserved.
AGENT_VOIP.MOVE_WINDOW: Move webphone (drag or use arrow keys)
AGENT_VOIP.LEGACY_NOTICE: SIP/WebRTC no longer uses a Voice inbox. Configure the central in VoIP services and the extension in each agent's profile. Twilio and Meta integrations remain independent.
AGENT_VOIP.TITLE: Calls
AGENT_VOIP.PARTIAL: History observed by ViperChat. Calls while the app is closed are not yet synchronized with the VoIP service.
AGENT_VOIP.ONE_SERVICE: One active connection per agent. Select a service before configuring your extension.
AGENT_VOIP.NO_SERVICES: No VoIP service is available. Ask an administrator to configure and authorize one.
AGENT_VOIP.NO_BINDING: Configure your extension in your profile to make and receive calls.
AGENT_VOIP.SERVICE_MISMATCH: Select and activate this favorite's service in your profile before calling.
AGENT_VOIP.SECRET_SAVED: Credential configured. Leave blank to keep it.
AGENT_VOIP.TEST_OK: SIP registration confirmed. No call was started.
AGENT_VOIP.NAME: Name
AGENT_VOIP.SPEAKER: Audio output
AGENT_VOIP.OUTPUT_LIMIT: This device does not support selecting audio output in the browser.
AGENT_VOIP.SELF_CONFIG: Allow agents to configure their own extension
AGENT_VOIP.ALLOWED_USERS_HELP: Select agents by name. An empty selection allows all agents in this account.
AGENT_VOIP.SERVICE_HELP: Shared service configuration. Each agent manages extension credentials in their profile.
AGENT_VOIP.BUSY_HELP: End the call before changing the service or extension.
AGENT_VOIP.HISTORY_PENDING: Some observations have not been persisted. Keep the app open and check your connection.
AGENT_VOIP.ERROR: The action could not be completed. Check configuration, connection and permissions.
AGENT_VOIP.MICROPHONE_DENIED_HELP: The call could not be answered. Allow microphone access in your browser settings, then try a new call.
